name: Justas
heroTagline: Cybersecurity graduate focused on offensive security and threat analysis — turning coursework, CTFs and labs into real, demonstrable skill.
bio: I'm a recent cybersecurity graduate who likes taking systems apart to understand exactly how they fail — then writing up what I find so someone else doesn't have to learn it the hard way.
My coursework and personal labs span network security, penetration testing, and digital forensics, and I round it out with CTFs and home-lab projects most weekends.
I'm currently looking for a junior role in security analysis, penetration testing, or SOC operations where I can keep learning fast.
pullQuote: The projects below showcase labs and exercises I've worked through, with my own documentation and reflections.

projects.title: Internal Network Pentest Lab
projects.summary: Built a vulnerable Active Directory lab and ran a full internal penetration test — recon, privilege escalation and lateral movement — with a formal findings report.

projects.title: Phishing Detection Classifier
projects.summary: Trained a lightweight ML model to flag phishing emails from header and content features, reaching 94% accuracy on a held-out test set.

projects.title: CTF Write-ups
projects.summary: Ongoing collection of write-ups from HackTheBox, TryHackMe and campus CTFs — covering web exploitation, cryptography and reverse engineering challenges.

projects.title: Home SOC in a Box
projects.summary: A self-hosted mini security operations centre using Wazuh and Suricata, ingesting logs from a small virtual network to practise detection engineering.

projects.title: Malware Sandbox Analysis
projects.summary: Static and dynamic analysis of sample malware binaries in an isolated environment, documenting indicators of compromise and behaviour.

projects.title: Secure File-Sharing Tool
projects.summary: A command-line tool for end-to-end encrypted file transfer using AES-256 and RSA key exchange, built as a final-year capstone project.

timeline.title: B.Sc. Cybersecurity and Digital Forensics
timeline.desc: Graduated with a focus on network security, penetration testing and digital forensics.
